digest.component_or_area: env-var registry and config ownership scripts
propositions: The prefix field in KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS tuples is unused: all 9 live rows declare empty prefix and the only historical prefixed row (_rebar_env with REBAR_) was removed by RP-04 cutover.
The prefix application code (prefix + lit) is still wired in two CI gate scripts (_scan_call in gen_env_registry.py and _helper_access in check_config_ownership.py) despite having no live users.
The feature has zero production users and zero honest test coverage, making it an unused-but-wired maintenance hazard that cannot rot visibly.
Remove the prefix field from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS, reducing it from dict[str, tuple[int, str]] to dict[str, int], and eliminate prefix application logic from both consumers.
Update all tuple-shape-touching tests to use bare-int reads instead of tuple subscripting and prefix concatenation.
Verify docs/env-vars.md regenerates unchanged (no live row used a prefix) and all linting, type-checking, and test gates pass.
